description: This file implements a checkpoint server in C, providing functions to connect to a server via UNIX or TCP sockets, and to send commands for hibernating or waking up processes based on process ID. It includes socket connection handling, command transmission, and process control functions.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to a server specified by a locator, supporting UNIX and INET sockets, with a timeout.

methods.name: SendRcvCmd
methods.description: Sends a command to the server and receives a response, handling socket connection, data transmission, and response validation.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a hibernate (checkpoint) process for a given PID, using a specified data directory.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Wakes up (restores) a process with a given PID, using a specified data directory.
